A pampered pet dog gets separated from her owner, and is left stranded in Mexico struggling to avoid a dognapper and a ferocious Doberman, who are after her diamond collar. Luckily, a courageous German shepherd is on hand to help her get back home. Comedy, starring Piper Perabo and Jamie Lee Curtis, with the voices of Drew Barrymore and Andy Garcia.
Sing along with your favorite songs from 'Lady and the Tramp' with on-screen lyrics.

An orphan is forced to live a life of servitude by her cruel stepmother. The king of the realm she lives in organises a lavish ball to find a bride for his son, and a caring fairy godmother puts her magic to the task of turning the downtrodden girl into a princess. Animated fairytale, with the voices of Ilene Woods, William Phipps and Verna Felton.

A hard-working New Orleans waitress meets an arrogant prince who has been turned into a frog by a magic spell. When she tries to break the enchantment by kissing him, she also ends up transformed into an amphibian, and together they go in search of the voodoo queen who can change them back. Disney animated musical fantasy, with the voices of Anika Noni Rose and Bruno Campos.

An American heiress on holiday in Africa gets stranded in the wilderness, but is rescued by a primitive man who was raised by apes. When her cruel fiancee takes her back to the States, the besotted king of the jungle follows, but is unprepared for modern living. Comedy based on the TV cartoon series, starring Brendan Fraser, Leslie Mann, Thomas Haden Church and Richard Roundtree.

Underwater princess Ariel becomes bored with her aquatic existence and spends her time spying on humans, much to the annoyance of her father. Longing to live on land, she strikes a deal with a banished sea witch in order to become human and meet a prince - but there is a price to be paid. Disney's animated adventure, with the voices of Jodi Benson, Christopher Daniel Barnes and Rene Auberjonois.

In 1930s London, Michael Banks lives in his family home with his children, Annabel, John, and Georgie. Still grieving the death of his wife, and behind on loan payments, his house is due to be repossessed unless he comes up with the money soon. Thankfully, help comes in the form of the practically perfect nanny who returns 25 years after her previous visit. Musical fantasy, starring Emily Blunt, Dick Van Dyke and Meryl Streep.

After the murder of his father Mufasa, young lion prince Simba flees his African kingdom, only to learn the true meaning of responsibility and bravery as he clashes with his wicked uncle Scar. Director Jon Favreau's animated remake of Disney's 1994 blockbuster, featuring the voices of Donald Glover, Beyonce Knowles and Seth Rogen.

A princess defies her mother's plans to secure peace by marrying her off to the son of one of their allies. A witch provides the rebellious royal with a magic spell to change her fate, but the enchantment backfires disastrously when the queen is transformed into a bear. Pixar's animated fantasy, with the voices of Kelly Macdonald, Emma Thompson and Billy Connolly.

A prince is transformed into a hideous monster as punishment for his selfishness, and can only regain his human form by finding true love. Salvation comes in the form of a spirited village girl, who offers to take her father's place when he is imprisoned in the monster's castle. But as romance blossoms between the unlikely pair, a jealous rival suitor only sees a beast to be slain. Live-action remake of the Disney animated fairy tale, starring Emma Watson, Dan Stevens and Luke Evans, with Ewan McGregor, Emma Thompson and Ian McKellen playing the Beast's entourage of living ornaments.

A widow boards a plane with her daughter and promptly falls asleep. When she wakes up, the girl has disappeared - and the mother's fear turns to outright panic when the aircraft crew insists she boarded the flight alone, suggesting the child is merely a figment of her distressed imagination. Thriller, starring Jodie Foster, Peter Sarsgaard, Sean Bean and Greta Scacchi.

p.t: The Life Aquatic with Steve Zissou
p.d: An eccentric marine expert sets out in search of a legendary shark that ate his old friend and shipmate. Unfortunately the voyage is riddled with problems, including a man claiming to be his long-lost son, a pursuing pirate crew and a rival oceanographer. Wes Anderson's comedy drama, starring Bill Murray, Owen Wilson, Cate Blanchett, Willem Dafoe and Jeff Goldblum.

A US ambassador who adopted his son in suspicious circumstances is troubled by the child's increasingly disturbing behaviour. A priest contacts him and claims the boy is the offspring of the Devil, but the father refuses to believe it - until a spate of deaths convinces him otherwise. Remake of the 1976 horror classic, starring Liev Schreiber, Julia Stiles, Seamus Davey-Fitzpatrick and Pete Postlethwaite.

Following his success with North by Northwest, director Alfred Hitchcock makes a daring choice for his next project: an adaptation of Robert Bloch's novel Psycho. After being refused backing by the studio Hitchcock decides to pay for it himself in exchange for a percentage of the profits. Even with His wifes support, Alma Reville, the production strains the couples marriage. Fact-based drama, starring Anthony Hopkins, Helen Mirren and Scarlett Johansson.

A doting dad is taken aback when his daughter announces she is getting married, and is thrown into a whirlwind of increasingly complicated wedding plans, a struggle to live up to the expectations of his wealthy future in-laws and the sad realisation that his little girl has grown up. Remake of the 1950s comedy, with Steve Martin, Diane Keaton, Kimberly Williams and Martin Short.

The programme focuses on the tragic events of September 1961, when a Douglas DC-6 operated by Transair Sweden, carrying Dag Hammarskjöld, the second Secretary-General of the United Nations, crashed en route to cease-fire negotiations in Northern Rhodesia during the Congo Crisis. All 16 passengers and crew members were killed.

What's the nicest thing in the whole world? That's right-doing a good deed! Tyra turns in caps for recycling and helps the whole world! But what do Ricky and Boo do? They just play on the playground.
Do you know what an ear-hamster is? You've definitely come across one more than once! When you hear some melody or song, and then hum it all day-that's an ear hamster!
What can be done with things that aren't needed? Give them to someone who needs them. Great idea! All that remains is to find the things that really-really aren't needed.
One day, Tyra takes Ricky with her on a school field trip to the museum.
Summer is the best! You can chase a ball, run on the grass, play badminton, and bask in the sun. But what is there to do when winter comes? Absolutely nothing! You can't even kick a ball.
Mom Saur grows the tastiest berries in the world. Everyone loves them: Dad Saur, Tyra, Ricky, the pterodactyls... Oh! Those pterodactyls again!
On some days, things just don't go right. The kind of day that gets off on the wrong foot! Unlucky days. Before, every fifth day was like this for Ricky. But everything is about to change!
There's quite the commotion in Dinocity! A journalist from a well-known TV program has announced that the person who makes the most interesting report about the life of the city will appear on TV.

Grandpa Saur has always dreamed of some extraordinary adventure! For example, to meet a real space alien! For many years, grandfather has been looking in a telescope in the hopes of spotting an alien.
Did you think invisibility cloaks existed only in fairytales? No way! Boo has his dad's wildlife photography cloak. It lets you camouflage with any environment, so that no one will notice you.
Ricky and Tyra love playing with their dad. But they're already a little tired of Dinopoly, ring-toss, and puzzles. But resourceful Dad Saur has come up with a new game: The Floor is Lava.
One day, Ricky finds a lamp in a pile of old trash. It looks just like a magic lamp with a genie inside! Though no genie actually comes out of it.
What can be scarier than stories told late at night, in a tent, by the lamplight? When shadows tremble on the wall, and even the sweetest little ghost story sounds seriously scary!
Kraken is the favourite pet of the Saur family! He follows Ricky and Tyra everywhere. This time, Kraken was playing with them in the yard. And then he got lost!

p.t: The Last Hunt For Nazi Gold
p.d: E4Guy Walters and Justine follow one of the most famous legends of WWII: the Wałbrzych Gold Train. Their search through Poland blends tense encounters, eccentric characters, and moments of farce as they try to separate fact from fantasy.
E3Weapons experts test the physical and psychological impact of close combat weapons - the Roman short sword, the medieval war hammer and the bayonet.
E4From the crossbow to the Kalashnikov to 3D-printed firearms, weaponry designed for everyone can offer a decisive advantage in warfare.
E2In Stealth we examine the methods ships have used to evade detection. With the advent of radar in WW2, ships that wanted to remain undetected had to find ways to hide.
E1Viking combat ships changed the course of history. Their longships brought William the Conqueror’s troops to Hastings, adventurers to North America and raiders to plunder the Saxon kingdoms.

E1The F15 Eagle immediately turned the tide of the first Gulf War to prove its greatness. Our immaculately restored MiG Killer was involved in one of the most bizarre combat incidents during that conflict, and has survived to tell the tale.

E2The mighty Flying Fortress takes to the air as we examine the background and development of one of WWIIs most iconic bombers. Serving with both the USAAF and the RAF, we see it in action and fly a surfing example.

E3At Stalingrad, the German 6th Army is destroyed by the Soviets. It’s the first major defeat of the Third Reich, which marks the beginning of its decline. Elsewhere, after the American victory at Guadalcanal, Japan loses the initiative in the Pacific.

E4Operation Overlord is launched. With the Normandy Landings, the Allies pierce the Atlantic Wall. In the East, the Red Army sweeps through Belarus with Operation Bagration, annihilating the Wehrmacht. The end of the Third Reich is near.
E5In spectacular experiments, a team of international experts presents the most significant cases in the history of weapons where speed has made a decisive difference.
